definitions.explanation: A technical drawing or plan showing the design of a building, machine, or other structure. Used in architecture, engineering, and construction.

examples.japanese: {図面|ずめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧{図面|ずめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。

{図面|ずめん}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked on site whether the construction was proceeding according to the plans.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard technical term in architecture, engineering, and manufacturing. {図面|ずめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to draw plans) is the most common collocation. Nowadays, many {図面|ずめん} are produced using CAD (computer-aided design) software.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {図面|ずめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to draw up plans/blueprints
- ⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧{図面|ずめん}: design drawings
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧{図面|ずめん}: architectural drawings
- {図面|ずめん}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧: according to the plans
